about_the_game:
THE FIRST TALE FROM THE COXISTENCE SERIES. GENERAL TARGE FINDS HIMSELF IN A TUG OF WAR FOR THE SNOWY NORTH-EAST CITY OF AUSTRI. ONE OF FOUR NOVIUS TERRITORIES LOOKING TO BE RECAPTURED BY ITS FORMER ANCIENT QUEEN, WITH WHOM HIS PATH HAS CROSSED BEFORE. PRIDE IS A HARD THING TO SWALLOW BUT DEFEAT IS EVEN HARDER.

This DLC contains 1 audiobook & Flipbook of "The Fall of Austri" also contains free gift of "The Austri Pack" Which contains 5 digital character cards for Coxistence - Full Game.

content_descriptors.notes: In the Fall of Austri book & Auiobook, there is a very minor amount of bad language and the story has elements of violence but the are no images depicting violence.
